messages.text:
Happy to help you pick. The two we actually recommend are the Harlo B30 and the Magic M. 40T, and which one wins depends on your power price.

Which state are you in? I'll run the numbers on your electricity rate and show you what each one stacks per month, the power cost, and the solo-block odds. If you know your rate per kWh, even better, tell me that too.

My calculator doesn't hold Quebec rates, so these are at a generic $0.17/kWh. Quebec hydro is far cheaper, so your real numbers look better than this.

Magic M. 40T, $799: about 57,300 sats a month (~$49 today), power $81/month at that rate, break-even BTC $140,691.
Harlo B30, $899: about 43,000 sats a month (~$37), power $50/month, break-even $116,882.

What's your rate per kWh? I'll rerun it properly.
